headlines.label: Group PO value, Oct 2025 – Sep 2026
headlines.sentence: Confirmed customer orders were S$53.4M in Oct 2025 – Sep 2026, +4.0% on the 12 months before (+7.6% in Jul–Sep), counted on de-duplicated customers. Synthetic, illustrative data.

headlines.label: Forecast error, today's method vs ours (Products A + B)
headlines.sentence: Today's rolling 12-month average is off by 11 units per 100 ordered; our seasonal model is off by 9, on 6 backtest months it never saw. It wins 7 of 10 country × product cells and loses 3, which we show. Illustrative, synthetic data.
headlines.note: Final model decision 7: shown on Pulse with the stress test; never in the close or the slide headline tiles.
headlines.caveat: The 6 pre-registered backtest months (Apr–Sep 2026) cover the rise of the dengue season, where a rolling average lags most. Not pre-registered: at six off-season origins the gain is +0.2 points (9.7 vs 9.5 per 100); over all 12 origins 10.5 vs 9.0 per 100.

headlines.label: Duplicate customer records found
headlines.sentence: 25 of 388 customer records are duplicates of 363 real customers. Merging them changes no country total, but it shows that Bukit Damai Specialist Hospital, Malaysia's #2 account, is down 32%; re-coding three Singapore records moves S$1.06M of orders back to Malaysia and Vietnam.

headlines.label: Setup time for a new record
headlines.sentence: Today's median is 14 days (Amy's item took 18). One form, parallel approvals in Teams with a 2-business-day SLA, and an SAP import file bring the target median to 4 business days or less; about 43% of the time saved is a process change that needs no new software.

headlines.label: Phase-1 payback
headlines.sentence: Phase 1 costs about S$39.9k, with no new licences for the workflow (phase 1), and releases ~1,751 hours a year (≈0.94 FTE), paying back in about 5.9 months at 80 requests a month.

supporting.label: Forecast gain from cleaning master data first (points per 100 ordered)
supporting.sentence: Cleaning master data alone cuts today's forecast error by 1.7 points per 100 ordered; on clean data our model cuts a further 2.8. On uncleaned records our model is worse than today's (15 vs 13 per 100): clean first, then model.

supporting.label: Duplicate matcher on countries it was not tuned on (TH, VN, MM)
supporting.sentence: On Thailand, Vietnam and Myanmar, which it was never tuned on, the matcher catches 87 of every 100 real duplicates, and of 100 duplicate warnings 93 are real (13 found, 2 missed, 1 false alarm).

supporting.label: Malaysia key account revealed by merging duplicates
supporting.display: Bukit Damai Specialist Hospital: −32% YoY (#2 in MY)
supporting.sentence: On raw SAP records Bukit Damai Specialist Hospital looks like one lost customer, one new one and one flat one (3 records); merged, it is Malaysia's #2 account and down 32% on last year.

supporting.label: Falsification test: our advantage with the signal switched off
supporting.display: Base dataset: +2.8 pts · Seasonality and trend switched off: -0.6 pts · Different seed, dengue amplitude halved: +2.3 pts
supporting.sentence: With seasonality and trend switched off our advantage is -0.6 points (within ±2, i.e. ≈ 0), so the method is not finding patterns that are not there. With a different seed and half the dengue effect it still wins by 2.3 points (smaller than the base 2.8, as expected with less seasonality).

supporting.label: Inbox sorting accuracy on a blind test set
supporting.sentence: On 60 messages written without seeing the rules, the rules put 92 of every 100 in the right stream (88 of 100 on the 33 deliberately tricky ones). A person still confirms every routing.

supporting.label: Hard benefit: capacity released at 80 requests a month
supporting.sentence: 1,751 h a year (≈0.94 FTE) of analyst, requestor and MDM time at S$50/h = S$81,543 a year after run cost; 3-year net S$205k.

supporting.label: Opportunity (illustrative, before conversion; never summed)
supporting.display: drop-off S$2.64M at risk · cross-sell S$1.02M addressable
supporting.sentence: S$2.64M of last-year orders sit with accounts showing drop-off (before a 25% assumed save rate) and S$1.02M of cross-sell is addressable (before a 15% assumed conversion). Synthetic data; never added to payback or to each other.

rule: One source of truth: every number here is copied from the file and path named next to it; the app, video script and slides quote these sentences verbatim. Forecast accuracy stays on Pulse, not in the close.
